grid.cost_and_time_rule: One separate quality request plus six complete timed requests per case/method/seed. No free reuse of quality construction, H, export or validation in timed requests. Timed complete routes/costs must remain consistent with the frozen deterministic method/input; charge all failures and cache hits separately.

stage_authorization_schema.exact_bindings: same exact identities + S2_complete map + policy_seeds + caps
stage_authorization_schema.authorization_source: project-relative saved real user S3 decision

resume: Same immutable authority and canonical directory only; closed complete-request boundaries retain all starts, errors, timers and log chain/HEAD. Dirty session or failed request stops for explicit recovery, never free replay.

statistics.bootstrap: 20000 physical-parent-cluster resamples, PCG64 seed11632026, same declared parent resample indices used across matched methods/controls within each cell. Seen6 and unseen12 parents separate; not108 independent environments; intervals not simultaneous familywise coverage.
statistics.quality_aggregation: Within each group,size,method,seed: average two endpoint-child J values for each physical parent. For pooled estimate then average the three matched optimizer-seed parent values; compute parent-relative gain from these method means, then equally average parent gains. FrozenSL/continuedSL are matched to their own seed lineage. Bootstrap true physical parent clusters only.
statistics.RL_gate_per_cell: For BOTH frozenSL and continuedSL: all cases valid; mean paired parent-relative gain >=0.5%; percentile two-sided95 bootstrap lower (2.5th percentile)>0; each of3 optimizer-seed point gains strictly positive. All6 group-size cells required for overall independent-RL claim.
statistics.deployment_gate_per_stratum: For each group,size,cache: all cases valid; parent-aggregated RLplusH degradation versus Detour16 one-sided95 percentile upper (95th percentile)<=0.5%; pooled complete-request median time ratio<=0.7 and p95 ratio<=1; RLplusH not Pareto dominated by Fixed3 on meanJ/median/p95 (all <= and at least one strict is domination). All12 strata required for overall deployment claim.
statistics.timing_aggregation: Within each group,size,cache, pool all parent x endpoint x seed x3repeat request timings for descriptive median/p95. Quality uses parent units, not request count. Endpoint-specific tables always reported; no causal endpoint/position comparison.
statistics.primary_decision: Overall independent-RL claim requires all6(group x size) quality cells; overall deployment claim requires all12(group x size x cache) strata. Both classes AND only for a combined quality-and-deployment claim; no pooled rescue. Partial per-cell evidence may be reported with explicit limited scope, not overall pass.
statistics.statistical_scope: One preregistered data-bank screen with3optimization repeats, not3independent datasets. CIs not advertised as simultaneous acrossallcells. No claim of pure-gradient/equal-FLOPs causality becauseRL states on-policy andSL teacher pool fixed.

budget_note: Hard ceilings, not runtime predictions. Startup/restoration/preparation/cache/IO charged per declared timer scope; scientific outcomes not yet observed.
